claims.text: The hotel's transformation conceived in 2020 and 2023 was by designers Sanjit Manku and Patrick Jouin.

findings.quote: the extraordinary metamorphosis conceived in 2020 and 2023 by Sanjit Manku and Patrick Jouin

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler says La Mamounia was turned into a hotel in the early 1900s and that guests have included FDR and Churchill.

findings.quote: Turned into a hotel in the early 1900s and owned in part by the royal family, everyone from FDR to Churchill stayed here.

claims.text: The restaurants include Asian cuisine curated by Jean-Georges Vongerichten, Italian by Simone Zanoni and Moroccan by Chef Rachid Agouray.

findings.quote: Moroccan flavours infused with spices and reimagined by Chef Rachid Agouray, vibrant Italian specialities by Simone Zanoni, or a grand culinary journey through Asia curated by Jean-Georges Vongerichten

claims.text: Pierre Hermé created exclusive Date and Earl Grey and Amlou macarons for La Mamounia.

findings.quote: his exclusive creations for La Mamounia, the Date and Earl Grey and Amlou Macarons

claims.text: Le Pavillon de la Piscine is the place for Sunday Brunch.

findings.quote: The shaded terrace of the Pavillon de la Piscine invites you to enjoy classic dishes
This is also the place to head for Sunday Brunch

claims.text: The kitchens draw fresh herbs and vegetables from the hotel's own kitchen garden.

findings.quote: a quick stroll through La Mamounia's vibrant kitchen garden is all it takes to find a wealth of fresh herbs and vegetables

claims.text: The hotel has pools, a gym, tennis courts and gardens planted with roses, orange, olive and palm trees.

findings.quote: the pools, gym, tennis courts and shady walkways in the sublime Gardens, awash with roses, orange, olive and palm trees

claims.text: The hotel has a spa with hammams.

findings.quote: The spa and hammams are the perfect place to indulge in a spot of pampering.

claims.text: A vintage games room tucked away in the gardens has pinball and a pool table.

findings.quote: tucked away in the Gardens, a delightful vintage games room will tempt young and old alike to fight it out over a game of pinball, pool table

claims.text: All bathrooms have a separate shower and bathtub, finished in marble and mashrabiya wooden latticework.

findings.quote: Enjoy the luxury of our bathrooms, all with separate shower and bathtub, sumptuously decked out in marble and mashrabiya wooden latticework.

claims.text: Suites have one to three bedrooms and are described as ideal for families and friends.

findings.quote: Featuring one to three bedrooms, our range of suites are ideal for families and friends.

claims.text: The Koutoubia Mosque, Place Jamaa el-Fna and the Medina are a few minutes from the hotel.

findings.quote: In just a few minutes, you will be before the magnificent Koutoubia Mosque, then in the bustling Place Jamaa el-Fna or the narrow streets of the Medina

claims.text: The Centenary Chandelier, a sculpture of light that pays homage to traditional Berber jewellery, greets guests as they walk through the doors.

findings.quote: culminating in the fabulous Centenary Chandelier. This magnificent sculpture of light, which pays homage to traditional Berber jewellery, captivates the eye from the moment you walk through the hotel doors

claims.text: The Riads have their own private entrances, pools and terraces.

findings.quote: With their own private entrances, pools and terraces, our Riads allow you to enjoy La Mamounia experience

claims.text: Pierre Hermé's tea rooms are Le Menzeh in the heart of the gardens and one on the Andalusian patio.

findings.quote: choose between the charming Menzeh par Pierre Hermé in the heart of the Gardens or the dazzling Andalusian patio

claims.text: A small cinema in blue velvet is hidden behind a sliding door.

findings.quote: In a haven of blue velvet, concealed behind a sliding door, lies a delightful little Cinéma.

claims.text: Three large lanterns house the Oenotheque and two private lounges.

findings.quote: Three large Lanternes house the extraordinary Œnothèque and two private lounges

claims.text: A minimum stay is required for certain periods, including Easter, All Saints and the end-of-year festivities.

findings.quote: A minimum stay is required for certain periods during the year including Easter, All Saints and for the end of year festivities.

claims.text: The hotel is 6 km from Marrakech-Menara airport, about 10 minutes by car; Exceptional Suite guests get a private transfer between the hotel and the airport.

findings.quote: La Mamounia is located at 6 km from the airport “Marrakech-Menara”. A journey time of 10 minutes by car.
Guests in our Exceptional Suites also benefit from a private transfer between the hotel and the Marrakech-Menara airport.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers.
